messages:
sasha: Quick sync — need final sign-off on the quality/regression gates for the gptx-small-q4 quant bring-up before we start canary today. High level plan: run full eval harness + targeted adversarial probes, then a limited canary on Dedicated. Questions: which prompt sets are hard blockers, exact delta thresholds to use, and what rollout/holdpoints do we enforce?

devon: +1. propose these primary metrics: semantic similarity (embedding cosine) relative delta <= 2% vs fp16 baseline on the production prompt set; hallucination rate absolute increase <= 0.5pp; answer token-length change within +/-10%; safety failure rate no increase. Also enforce latency budget: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms on Dedicated.

maria: For prompt sets I recommend: 1) prod-golden (1k canonical prompts), 2) domain-extractors (500 edge cases), 3) regen-probes (200 adversarial paraphrases), 4) safety-suite (500). Run each with 3 deterministic seeds (seed=42, 43, 44) to capture nondet variance. Aggregate with paired bootstrap for CI. Flag if lower bound of CI crosses threshold.

raj: Add a long-context holdpoint — kv-cache fidelity check with 8k token prefix sequences. We've seen subtle drift on context carryover after quant changes. Test: repeat-qa sequence that relies on prior context; require exact match rate >= 98%.

sasha: Good call @raj. Also we should compute per-prompt delta distributions, not just mean. If >5% of prompts have regression >5% (cosine), mark as blocker.

devon: For statistical tests: paired bootstrap + Wilcoxon signed-rank as backup; require p < 0.05 AND effect size within our delta bounds. For small sample adversarial sets (n<300) be conservative and use a 95% CI on median.

maria: Quick snippet for metric calc we should put in the harness docs:```
# percent delta (higher worse for score drops)
delta_pct = (baseline_score - quant_score) / max(1e-8, baseline_score) * 100
```
And for hallucination rate: compute token-level hallucination flagged by aligner + manual spot check on 50 samples.

raj: Canary rollout ops: start 1% traffic for 2h with detailed logging, then 5% for 4h if no holds, then 20% for 24h. On any hold, auto-fallback to fp16 model. Include logged traces for any prompt where semantic similarity drop > 5% so SRE/ML can triage.

canary-bot: canary-bot: noted. will attach per-request sampling logs to /mnt/canary-logs/gptx-small-q4/{{date}}. Traces include model_variant, latency_ms, embedding_cosine, safety_flag.

eval-bot: eval-bot: scheduled full harness: prod-golden (1k), domain-extractors (500), regen-probes (200), safety-suite (500). Staging run started; ETA ~ 45m. Outputs will be in CI artifact: gs://redwood-evals/gptx-small-q4/2301112222/*

sasha: Final checklist (holdpoints):
- smoke harness run: no fatal errors and >95% pass on quick smoke set
- regression gate: semantic delta <=2% mean AND median within bounds AND not >5% prompts >5% drop
- safety gate: no increase in safety failures (absolute) >0.5pp
- long-context gate: kv-cache exact match >=98% on repeat-qa
- latency gate: p50/p95 within budget above
- ops gate: canary logging & auto-fallback configured in rollout policy
If all green, proceed to 5% canary. If any single gate fails, hold and create a triage ticket with artifacts and top 50 failing prompts.

maria: I'll kick off the manual spot checks for hallucination samples and review the top-50 failures once eval-bot artifacts are up.

devon: I'll add the paired-bootstrap code to the harness and wire the Wilcoxon check. Also adding a small script to produce the per-prompt delta histogram and a CSV of flagged prompts.

raj: I'll prepare the kv-cache sequences and the canary rollout config (autoscale policy + fallback).

sasha: Great — thanks all. tagging this thread as the single source for decisions. If anyone finds new blocker thresholds during the run, post here and we’ll decide fast. :thumbsup:
